Nk.bar_b_note: Bright sky and oak canopy help, but the props are small, crowded by a wolf, rabbit and tall grass carpet, and the camp has no lived-in staging next to the Palworld base shot.

Wq.bar_b_note: The purple storm sky and rain set a mood, but the landmark is a grass edge over a flat blue-grey plane, and B's stone ring of glass spikes is a marker, not a sink.

Io.bar_b_note: Glowing mushrooms and the blue glow channel give Stormwood colour, but the glass field reads as a few shards on a purple slab with no light interplay or depth haze at Valheim finish.

Sd.bar_b_note: B's black-and-yellow banded serpent has a strong standing silhouette, but the faint poses float it off the ground, and A's mottling turns the coils into a muddy mass.

Eb.bar_b_note: A well-finished, appealing elder villager with a warm earthy palette, but he is styled closer to animated-film cartoon than stylised realism and is shown with no world around him.

Ww.bar_b_note: The Stormcapra fleece and horns match the owner bar when standing, but B's faint mid and end scramble the mesh into flat white and black shards, and the ram barely clears the trainer's height.

Yo.bar_b_note: B's timber frame, diagonal brace, cap and stone footing read as built, but it is still a thin standalone panel with flat tan infill, sitting in a carpet-flat meadow.

Xk.bar_b_note: A's blue crystal clusters and glowing moss have a material cue, but the nodes sit alone on a uniform dark moss carpet under a flat purple sky with no grounding light or density.

Eo.bar_b_note: The tan speed mushroom with a blue glow and the orange wild cluster now separate clearly, but the blocky ochre rocks and smooth flat grass read as placeholder, not Cloudreach's pale stratified stone.

top_changes.change: Build the Glass Sink as a real authored basin: a sloped rim with marked approach, a visible glass floor or black pool with reflections, and spike clusters set into the descent, replacing the flat plane past the grass edge.

Give Stormwood resource and landmark nodes material-forward staging: emissive glass and glow cues, contact-shadow and debris decals at their bases, and break the uniform moss carpet around them into clearings so they read at 30% size.
Ground the faint poses (Sd B floats off the stage, Ww B mesh scrambles) and keep the root pinned to the floor through hurt and faint so creatures read without a label.
